title: Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions: Covered Seats
content:
A Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions product that covers seats covers an extra-legroom Main Plus seat, and also a preferred seat when the subscription includes preferred seats, for the subscriber and each covered companion on the same reservation, per segment, on itineraries whose itinerary class is one of the subscription's seat itinerary classes, assigned at the time the subscription's seat assignment timing allows.

## Conditions and results

1. **Active subscription.** Benefits are used only while the subscription is active. The status is the one the company's records show for the very subscription whose seat benefit is being used, read before the seat is recorded as a covered seat; a subscription in purchased, expired or cancelled status gives no covered seat.
2. **Unit of use.** One covered seat for one traveler on one segment is one use, and uses count toward the subscription's most benefit uses per term, together with covered-bag uses recorded on the same subscription in the current term, from the term's start date to the date the matter is handled.
3. **Kinds of ticket and flight.** The exclusions for partner-operated flights, Crestline Basic Economy, group fares, Summit award tickets and companion-certificate tickets are the same as for covered bags: no covered seat on partner-operated flights when the subscription does not apply to partner flights, none on Crestline Basic Economy unless the subscription applies to Basic Economy, none on group fares unless the subscription applies to group bookings, and on Summit award and companion-certificate tickets as the subscription's award-ticket and companion-ticket settings say.
4. **Seat fees paid before the purchase.** Seat fees already paid on unflown segments within the subscription's seat-fee refund window, counted in calendar days before the purchase date of the subscription, are refunded under the fee-refund rule of the Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand rules as charged in error.
5. **Involuntary reassignment.** A covered seat lost to an involuntary reassignment is replaced by another covered seat where one is available, and earns nothing further when the subscription's setting for anything beyond reassignment to another covered seat is No.

## Questions on the rule

**Is a preferred seat covered as well as the extra-legroom Main Plus seat?**
Only when the subscription includes preferred seats.

**When can the covered seat be assigned?**
At the time the subscription's seat assignment timing allows: at booking for a subscription whose timing is at booking, at check-in for one whose timing is at check-in, and never for one whose seat benefit is none.

**Does a companion on another reservation get a covered seat?**
The seat benefit is for the subscriber and each covered companion on the same reservation.

**What does a holder receive when a covered seat is lost to an involuntary reassignment and no other covered seat is available?**
Where the subscription's setting for anything beyond reassignment is No, the covered seat earns nothing further.

## Seat fees paid before purchase (hypothetical window of 7 calendar days)

| Seat fee | Segment | Paid within the window before the purchase date | Refunded as charged in error |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paid 2 days before the purchase date | Unflown | Yes | Yes |
| Paid 2 days before the purchase date | Already flown | Yes | Not under this rule |
| Paid 30 days before the purchase date | Unflown | No | Not under this rule |
